title: Naturally Spawning Sniffers
description: They spawn in the lush cave biome. Enjoy and have fun finding sniffers. Known Bug: They sometimes spawn in the walls of the cave so make sure to mine them out.
body:
My first proper Minecraft Mod

It just makes Sniffers Spawn in Lush Caves

Have fun getting a sniffer without messing with the archeology system and ocean ruins. This mod is a simple mod and does not add anything new outside of sniffers spawning in lush caves.
